items.title: Ray Bauduc and Nappy Lamare Interview, 1959-09-09
items.q: I think it was October the 13th when we played with Doc Shue showing and the whole gang down there.

ctx.x: Well, I hope so. Me too. When you get back home to New Orleans, we'll have more time in the home. Maybe a half hour interview or so for each one of you. I hope so. And because they're putting us in the Tulane Library, you might say. Oh, that's wonderful. So your voices will be preserved and the information about all the news stations that come from there. Oh, that's nice. I hope to interview you last fall there when you were on the riverboat that night, remember?
Oh, yeah. Well, yeah, I think it was October the 13th when we played with Doc Shue showing and the whole gang down there. Oh, that was a wonderful deal. All our families.
